# cargo-mutants 27.1.0 — 2026-09-14

- crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/cargo-mutants (2026-06-02)
- docs: https://mutants.rs/
- repo: https://github.com/sourcefrog/cargo-mutants
- license: MIT
- MSRV to *build* the tool: 1.88 (we test with rustc 1.98.1)

## Install

```sh
cargo install --locked cargo-mutants
```

## Commands

`--in-place` conflicts with `-j`. Use parallel copies:

```sh
cd cli && cargo mutants -j 4
cd cli && cargo mutants -j 4 -f src/config.rs
```

Outcomes: **caught** (test failed), **missed** (tests still pass), **timeout**, **unviable** (does not compile). Exit 0 all caught; 2 missed; 3 timeouts; 4 baseline failed.

Config: `.cargo/mutants.toml` (no Cargo.toml metadata). Integration tests must use `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_msn")`, not a hardcoded `target/debug/msn`. Do not pass `--lib` or CLI `main` mutants look missed.

Skip auto: `#[cfg(test)]`, `#[test]`. Optional `mutants` crate for `#[mutants::skip]`.
